_comment: Hand-authored copy. sync.mjs merges this over the generated data, so nothing here is overwritten by CI. Every number in it is verifiable against the repo — do not add a claim you cannot check.

hero._kicker: Deliberately omitted so lib/hero.mjs derives it as `GITHUB PROFILE · UPDATED <date>` from data.generatedAt — setting it here would freeze the date.
hero.tagline: 写工具，解决那些每个人都默默忍受的小问题。
hero.taglineEn: Small tools for problems everyone quietly puts up with.
